 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 06-08-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioners apprehend their arrest in a case registered for the offence under Sections 341,
342, 323, 506, 376 & 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of POCSO Act.

3. The Informant, namely Indra Kumari aged 16 years, alleged that on 16.12.2022, petitioner no. 5 (Dinesh Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24281 of 2025(3) dt.06-08-2025 Yadav) took her to Rajasthan by alluring her for marriage, made physical relation with her.
Later on, she came to know that he is already married.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that entire prosecution case, as set out in F.I.R., is concocted and baseless.
F.I.R. depicts that both of them i.e. informant and petitioner no. 5 (Dinesh Yadav) lived together, as husband and wife for more than three years.
Even, in statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim has categorically stated that she went alongwith this petitioner and during investigation, she refused to be medically examined.
So far as other petitioners are concerned, they are full brothers of petitioner no. 5 and have got no concern with the alleged occurrence.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail.

6. Considering the statement of victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and clean antecedent, let the above named petitioners, in the event of their arrest/surrender within a period of eight weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned District & Patna High Court CR.
